headers.//: The app ships unbundled ES modules at stable URLs, so a browser that caches views/index.js keeps running an old build after a deploy — and a version query on the entry point cannot reach modules it imports by fixed path. Revalidation is the fix: these files are tiny and a 304 costs almost nothing.
The page embeds nothing and talks only to Supabase and the two Google Fonts hosts, so it can afford a tight policy.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://gwepxpyfgtgagceguyhm.supabase.co wss://gwepxpyfgtgagceguyhm.supabase.co; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
